art_direction: Cosmic/constellation, Awwwards-level cinematic, askgpt.com style but more distinctive. Premium purposeful motion with a signature hero line-by-line reveal.

headings.rules: Use for all H1/H2/H3. Apply tracking-tighter. Use extreme weights (Light or Black) for tension. MUST import from Google Fonts.

body.rules: Clean, highly legible geometry. MUST import from fontshare or fallback to system sans-serif.

mono_labels.rules: Use for overlines, API docs, benchmark table headers, and tech details. Uppercase with tracking-[0.2em] for overlines. MUST import from Google Fonts.

colors.rules: NEVER use pure black or white. Base color for dark mode MUST be #1e2327 as per FrasbergAI's GitHub repo theme. Use tinted grays. Provide a fully functional light/dark theme toggle (defaulting to system preference).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Crystal Glass' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#1e2327]/60 or bg-white/70 with 1px delicate inner stroke border) for headers, sticky elements, and live chat widget. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use the 'Tracing Beam' concept for the Model Tier Cards (200M/1B/7B/70B) — animated border highlights on hover.
visual_enhancers.background_texture: Use subtle noise/grain overlay globally to kill digital flatness and enhance the cinematic feel.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive elements must shift in color, have a slight lift (-translate-y-1), and have high-contrast focus rings.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-24, p-32. Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-8) to prevent text collision.
layouts.grid: Use Bento Grid Protocol for Capabilities. Wide gaps (gap-8), asymmetric spanning (col-span-full md:col-span-8).
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text and tables. Never center by default; use grids and explicit alignment for tension.

hero.description: Kinetic text reveal (line-by-line masking), constellation map background, Web/Mobile App View Toggle, and the Luchii Live Chat Demo widget.
hero.motion: Framer Motion: overflow-hidden wrapper on text lines, initial y=100%, opacity=0, animate to y=0 with stagger.

marquee.description: Editorial slow-moving string using react-fast-marquee. Font: JetBrains Mono. Large spacing (gap-32).
marquee.text: PHASE VIII AGI • THE FIVE REALMS • LUCHII PRIME • EARTH • MARS • EUROPA • TITAN • META

model_tiers.style: Tracing beam borders on hover, dense tech specs (JetBrains Mono).

benchmarks.description: Clean comparison table (MMLU, GSM8K, HumanEval, MT-Bench).

five_realms.description: Cosmic map section detailing the six personas (Luchii Prime, Earth, Mars, Europa, Titan, Meta).
five_realms.layout: Asymmetric bento grid or horizontal layout with glowing 3D spheres/planets.

mythos_timeline.layout: Vertical line down the left side, massive numbers (text-6xl font-light) overlapping the line.

api_docs.description: Code blocks representing FrasbergAI's endpoint integration.
api_docs.style: Retro-Futurism terminal look within the block.

safety.description: Minimalist text pledge for AI safety.

motion.scrolling: MANDATORY: Use @studio-freight/react-lenis for premium smooth scroll (adds momentum and weight).
motion.animations: Framer Motion for scroll-triggered fade-ups, staggered lists, and the signature hero mask-reveal.
motion.background_3d: Use react-tsparticles for ambient constellation/cosmic dust in the hero/realms background.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gradients/images meets 4.5:1 using text-shadow.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='theme-toggle', data-testid='chat-demo-input', data-testid='view-toggle-btn').

hero_background.description: Abstract dark blue cosmic pattern (Constellation Layer background).

five_realms_spheres.description: Abstract bubbles glowing (Used for Earth/Mars/Europa/Titan persona representations).

meta_realm.description: Planet in space (Used for the Meta or Luchii Prime persona).

demo_dashboard.description: Digital assistant UI screen (Used in the Web/Mobile App toggle demo area).

api_servers.description: Detailed server rack (Used for API docs/Capabilities section).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React (.js) using Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.
Set up Tailwind configuration to support the #1e2327 base color for dark mode and the respective light mode variables.
Implement the Theme Toggle (Light/Dark) that defaults to system preference.
Implement the Web/Mobile App View Toggle in the Hero section, swapping the layout/dimensions of the live chat demo widget.
Integrate @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth scrolling wrapping the app.
Build the kinetic line-by-line text reveal in the Hero using Framer Motion (overflow-hidden wrapper around text, animating y from 100% to 0).
Use react-fast-marquee for the editorial marquee.
Do NOT use pure Inter/Roboto for headings. Import Unbounded and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and toggles have a data-testid attribute.
Do not center-align the main App container. Use semantic HTML and optical alignment.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Avoid emojis. Ensure high-end typography usage.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.transitions: DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease) to prevent breaking transforms.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.glassmorphism: Use 12-24px blur with appropriate backdrop saturation and a subtle 1px border. Never use complete transparent backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.component_reuse: Prioritize reusing Shadcn components if applicable and follow standard patterns. Use lucide-react for icons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner for any toast notifications.
